steps.title: Blueprint and object
steps.say: `BankAccount` is the blueprint. Each `new BankAccount(...)` builds a separate account with its own balance.

marks.label: call a method on one object

steps.title: Open Main.java
steps.say: Main is already written: it uses your class. Press **Ctrl+P**, type `Main` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

steps.title: Main uses it
steps.say: Main makes two accounts like this. Once your class works, it prints real balances.
